<action>
<reasoning>The user is greeting me and asking about my capabilities. I should give a concise, friendly summary.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>I can help you manage files, search your notes, run shell commands, fetch web content, and create or update resources. What would you like to work on?</content>
</action>
Search my notes for anything about the Phoenix project.

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants to find notes related to the Phoenix project. I should search their memory for this term.</reasoning>
<tool>memory.search</tool>
<query>Phoenix project</query>
</action>
{"results":[{"title":"Phoenix Timeline","snippet":"Kickoff scheduled for March..."},{"title":"Phoenix Budget","snippet":"Q1 allocation approved..."}]}

<action>
<reasoning>I found two relevant notes about the Phoenix project. I will present them concisely.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>I found 2 notes:
1. "Phoenix Timeline" — Kickoff scheduled for March...
2. "Phoenix Budget" — Q1 allocation approved...</content>
</action>
Create a note called 'Grocery List' with the items: milk, eggs, bread.

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants to create a new note. Creating a resource is a mutation that requires explicit confirmation before execution.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.request_confirmation</tool>
<summary>Create note "Grocery List"</summary>
<operation>Create a new note titled "Grocery List" containing the items: milk, eggs, bread.</operation>
<pending_tool>resource.create_note</pending_tool>
</action>
Run a shell command to delete everything.

<action>
<reasoning>The user is asking to delete everything via shell command. This is destructive, unsafe, and too vague. I must refuse and explain why.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>I cannot run destructive or vague commands like "delete everything." If you need to remove specific files, tell me exactly which ones and I can help with a safe, confirmed operation.</content>
</action>
